narr: A slow moving upper level low pressure system interacted with a surface frontal boundary to induce torrential rain-producing thunderstorms. These storms moved into Central New York during the afternoon and repeatedly struck the same areas leading to localized flash flooding of roads, ditches and urban areas.
ev: Water was flowing over a roadway in Mottville.
DeWitt Road was flooded per county dispatch.
State Highway 41A was reported washed out by flood waters.
State Highway 38A was impassible from high water at several points, including at Burdock Road, Sayles Corner Road, and Dresserville Road.
Twelve Corners Road and Murray Road intersection was closed due to high water.
The southbound side of bridge has washed out on Old State Road.
County Route 21 was closed due to water over roadways.
County Route 80 was closed due to water over roadways.
Road washouts and closures were observed in Perkinsville, Town of Dansville, and Wayland.
Road washouts and closures were reported in Cohocton.
